message: This is an interesting discussion, thanks for sharing it: I'm writing a piece for KairosNews on the Web as a space for writing that makes use of Negri and Hardt's notion of "immaterial labor." You might be interested in Negri's essay [Kairos, Alma Venus, Multitudo](http://www.blogalization.info/conspiracy/KairosAlmaVenusMultitudo). Also, Paolo Freire's Pedagogy of the Oppressed on overcoming class division in the teacher-student relationship.
